Each row scores the same saved fit on the labelled population; no refit is performed. R^2 uses 100 bins between the finite population 0.5th and 99.5th percentiles, with the existing finite-cell density scaling. The production verdict uses all finite scored cells.

docstrings.before:
Fit G1 and G2 peaks with an S phase between them to DNA content.

A Dean-Jett-Fox style mixture fitted by expectation maximisation: a
Gaussian G1 peak, a Gaussian G2 peak held between 1.6 and 2.4 times the
G1 position with the same coefficient of variation (at most 15 %, as
for any DNA stain that measures content), a uniform S phase between
the two peaks, and a flat
component of at most 15 % for debris, clumps and mis-segmented nuclei.
The fit starts from the G1 peak of the log histogram and ignores nuclei
below 0.35 or above 3.2 times it, which are fragments, nuclei cut by the
field edge and clumps rather than cells in a phase.

:param content: background-subtracted integrated DNA intensities of one
    plate; non-finite and non-positive values are ignored.
:param gates: optional ``[G1/S, S/G2]`` cuts in DNA content units, the
    G1 peak being 2 and the G2 peak 4; they replace the fitted
    crossings.
:param max_iter: iteration cap.
:param tol: convergence tolerance on the mean log-likelihood.
:returns: a :class:`_DnaFit`.
:raises ValueError: fewer than 30 usable nuclei, or gates that are not
    two increasing numbers.

:param content: background-subtracted integrated DNA intensities of one

:param gates: optional ``[G1/S, S/G2]`` cuts in DNA content units, the

:param max_iter: iteration cap.
:param tol: convergence tolerance on the mean log-likelihood.

docstrings.before:
G1, S, G2, subG1, >4N or M of every nucleus from field-centred DNA.

With ``centre``, the DNA content is taken as
``x = log2(max(content, 1))``, every field is shifted by
:func:`_dna_field_offsets` within its fit group, and the centred content
is ``2 ** (x - offset)``; without it the content is used as it is. One
:func:`_fit_dna_content` is fitted per group on its non-mitotic nuclei,
every nucleus of the group is gated with :func:`_gate_dna_content`, and
the nuclei of the external ``mitotic`` call are M. A group with too few
nuclei to fit is gated with the fit of all groups pooled.

:param content: background-subtracted integrated DNA intensity per
    nucleus, in row order.
:param groups: ``(name, positions)`` pairs, the rows of each fit group.
:param fields: the field of each nucleus; needed with ``centre``.
:param mitotic: optional boolean external mitotic call per nucleus.
:param centre: centre each field on its G1 peak first.
:param min_cells: the non-mitotic nuclei a field needs to be shifted.
:param gates: optional ``[G1/S, S/G2]`` in DNA content units.
:returns: ``(frame, fits)``: per nucleus ``field_offset_log2``,
    ``dna_content_centred``, ``phase``, ``confidence`` and the fitted
    ``posterior_G1``, ``posterior_S`` and ``posterior_G2``; ``fits``
    maps each group name to ``{'fit': _DnaFit, 'fields_shifted': int,
    'pooled': bool}``.

docstrings.before:
Measure's field-centred DNA-content call on an OPS cell table.

The ``ops_profile_cell_cycle_method 'measure_fc'`` path: one fit per
``group`` (well) on field-centred DNA, the fields being ``field``
(site), with the ``mitotic`` column as the external M call
(:func:`_field_centred_dna_phases`).

:param cells: one row per cell.
:param dna: the integrated nuclear DNA intensity column.
:param group: the fit-group column.
:param field: the field column, nested in ``group``.
:param mitotic: the boolean mitotic-call column.
:param min_cells: the non-mitotic cells a field needs to be shifted.
:returns: ``(frame, fits)`` of :func:`_field_centred_dna_phases`, the
    frame on the index of ``cells``; ``phase`` is G1, S, G2, subG1,
    >4N or M.
:raises ValueError: a column is missing.

Score recorded fit populations and the production population using each fixed fit.

:param cells: full OPS reference cells with their well labels.
:param dna: current centred DNA values, in the same row order.
:param fits: current fixed fits and optional exact fit-population records.
:returns: diagnostic rows only; missing retained populations remain unavailable.

Report checks, stage counts and notes, explaining unjudged DNA-fit stages.

A failed S6 R² below 0.90 labels its report row and G1, S and G2 as
not judged, with the measured R². Counts, check verdicts and collapse
decisions remain unchanged.
docstrings.source:
Report checks, stage counts and notes, explaining unjudged DNA-fit stages.

A failed S6 R² below 0.90 labels its report row and G1, S and G2 as
not judged, with the measured R². Counts, check verdicts and collapse
decisions remain unchanged. Optional retained populations appear in a
separate fixed-fit diagnostic block that never changes the verdict.
Retain fixed-fit S6 population diagnostics without changing production numbers.
Load the exact shared fit and field-centred pipeline from the task base.
Make two labelled wells with selected outliers, invalid DNA and excluded cells.
Keep every fitted field and output byte identical with capture off and on.
Expose pooled training rows instead of falsely labelling the tiny well as the fit input.
Retain all-finite S6 rows and verdicts while separately scoring the same fixed fit.
Refuse any attempt to refit while reporting diagnostics.
Keep missing fit-mask and trim provenance explicit when only a saved fit is available.
Render the full integer population size without the four-digit float rounding.
Keep the intended CPU fixture isolated from a GPU-visible worker cache.
